info.name: CRM - All Backend APIs
info.description: Generated from the FastAPI OpenAPI schema. Dummy bodies are examples and must be adjusted to valid tenant data before use. Authentication uses the CRM session cookie. Start with Authentication > POST /api/v1/auth/login; Postman retains crm_session automatically and the request script stores csrf_token in csrfToken for later mutating requests.
